# Nile Stone Café (نايل ستون كافيه)

> Nile Stone Café is a garden café right on the Nile in Manial El-Roda, Old Cairo, Cairo. It serves signature drinks and shisha, and is open daily from 3 PM to 3 AM. The whole venue can be booked privately for up to 40 guests: romantic dates, engagements, katb el-ketab, birthdays, family gatherings with open buffet, and a monthly girls' night.

## Key facts
- Name: Nile Stone Café — نايل ستون كافيه
- Type: Nile-side garden café and private event venue
- Address: 20 El-Malek El-Saleh St., Manial El-Roda, Old Cairo, Cairo, Egypt — 20 شارع الملك الصالح، منيل الروضة، مصر القديمة، القاهرة
- Opening hours: every day, 3:00 PM – 3:00 AM (Cairo time)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +201093195894
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nile.stone.cafe/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@nile.stone05
- Romantic date for two: from 800 EGP (decorated Nile-side table, candles, flowers, dinner)
- Private events (engagement, katb el-ketab, birthday, family gatherings/open buffet): from 2500 EGP, exact quote on request; up to 40 guests; the whole venue is closed for the event; package can include decor, food/open buffet, cake, photographer, DJ & sound, drinks
- Girls' Night: ladies only, monthly, Zumba + karaoke + nostalgia party; ticket 200 EGP; contact for the next date
- Other: fishing from the garden on the Nile is allowed; shisha served
- Drink prices: 15–140 EGP
- Booking: WhatsApp +201093195894, the booking form on the website, or Instagram DM

## FAQ
- Q: Where is Nile Stone Café?
  A: 20 El-Malek El-Saleh St., Manial El-Roda, Old Cairo, Cairo. The café is a garden right on the Nile.
- Q: What are Nile Stone's opening hours?
  A: Open every day from 3 PM until 3 AM.
- Q: How much is a romantic date at Nile Stone?
  A: A romantic date for two starts from 800 EGP. It includes a decorated Nile-side table with candles and flowers, plus dinner. The final price depends on the extras you choose.
- Q: How much do events (engagement, katb el-ketab, birthday) cost?
  A: Events start from 2,500 EGP. Tell us what you need (guest count, food, decor, DJ, photography) and we'll send you an exact quote.
- Q: How many guests can the venue host?
  A: Up to 40 guests, and the whole venue is closed privately for your event.
- Q: Is the venue private during events?
  A: Yes. For private events the entire café is closed just for you.
- Q: What's included in an event package?
  A: Full decor, food and open buffet, cake, a photographer, DJ and sound, and drinks, all tailored to your request.
- Q: Does Nile Stone serve food?
  A: Food and open buffets are served for events and group dinners as part of the package. The everyday menu is hot drinks, juices, mojitos, smoothies, milkshakes and shisha.
- Q: Do you serve shisha?
  A: Yes. Fruit shisha is 100 EGP, mixed fruit is 120 EGP, and a disposable hygienic hose is available for 20 EGP.
- Q: What are drink prices at Nile Stone?
  A: Prices range from 15 EGP (water) to 140 EGP. Turkish coffee is 55, mojitos start at 90, smoothies at 80 and fresh juices at 60.
- Q: What is the Girls' Night at Nile Stone?
  A: A ladies-only night held once a month, with Zumba, karaoke and a nostalgia party. Tickets are 200 EGP. Message us to find out the next date.
- Q: When is the next Girls' Night?
  A: It runs monthly. Message us on WhatsApp (+20 109 319 5894) or Instagram and we'll tell you the nearest date.
- Q: Is it ladies only?
  A: Yes, Girls' Night is for women only.
- Q: Can I fish at Nile Stone?
  A: Yes! The garden sits right on the Nile, so bring your fishing rod and fish while you hang out.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: WhatsApp us on +20 109 319 5894, fill in the booking form on this site (it sends a ready-made WhatsApp message), or DM us on Instagram.
- Q: Is the café really on the Nile?
  A: Yes, seating is in an open garden directly on the Nile, facing the corniche lights at night.
- Q: Can I hold my katb el-ketab at Nile Stone?
  A: Yes. We set up a calm Nile-side ceremony, followed by a family celebration, for up to 40 guests. Packages start from 2,500 EGP.
- Q: Is it good for a small engagement?
  A: Yes. It suits an intimate family engagement of up to 40 guests, with the whole venue closed for you.
- Q: Can I choose the date decor color?
  A: Yes. Pick your color (purple, red, white & gold, pink or blue) and we'll set it up.
- Q: Can you help with a surprise or proposal?
  A: Yes. Share the idea on WhatsApp and we'll arrange it: flowers, cake, a special song, or any detail you like.
